item.title: Jason Obawemimo: founder of Olaceo and Obavia
item.description: Jason Obawemimo is the founder of Olaceo and Obavia and the owner and operator of Triple J Auto Investment, a Houston dealership, where he builds the CRM, voice AI and automation systems that run it. Olaceo (https://olaceo.com): AI that pays, for business owners and the builders who sell it. Obavia (https://obavia.co): live sales-call intelligence for closers on phone and video calls, in development, with a waitlist. Earlier descriptions of Obavia as a dealership sale desk are out of date; the dealership sale desk Jason built is Handle a Sale, in use at Triple J.

item.title: Jason Obawemimo's resume, October 2026: AI implementation, workflow automation and CRM systems
item.description: Jason Obawemimo is the founder of Olaceo and Obavia and the owner and operator of Triple J Auto Investment, a Houston dealership, where he builds the CRM, voice AI and automation systems that run it. Since June 2025 he has personally closed 53 vehicle sales and collected $206,777 in sale proceeds. At Triple J he built a custom dealership CRM with its Handle a Sale desk (one system, used daily by three staff), an inbound voice AI that books appointments into the CRM, and a prospecting workflow that researches leads with the Claude API. He is pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Neuroscience at The University of Texas at Austin, expected 2028, and holds an Associate of Arts in Business from San Jacinto College.

item.title: Triple J: Handle a Sale
item.description: A demo of Handle a Sale, the sale desk in the CRM Jason Obawemimo built for Triple J Auto Investment in Houston and the system the dealership closes sales on. It asks one plain question at a time, scans the buyer's license once so every form fills itself, does the registration math, routes the deal to the right documents with nothing missing and nothing extra, works in English or Spanish, and saves every sale on file.
